title: HeyHi Theme Config
description: Shopify-specific configuration layer for heyhi-shopify-theme. Sits alongside active-brand.json and provides theme identity, preset definitions, section library preferences, and compliance flags. Created once per theme (not per brand config refresh). Version: 1.0.0

name.description: Theme name. Must meet Shopify naming rules: 1-2 words, under 30 characters, not an industry name, not an existing theme name on the Theme Store.

version.description: Semantic version string. Start at 1.0.0 for first submission.

shopify_partner_id.description: Shopify Partner account ID. Required for submission. Set during Phase 0 (Session 0.1).

description.description: Short description of the theme. 1-2 sentences. No pricing. No claims not substantiated in the demo store.

support_url.description: URL for theme support. Must be live before submission. Link to heyhi.design/theme-support or a dedicated page.

documentation_url.description: URL for theme documentation. Must be live before submission. Required to have minimum FAQ section (5 questions).

industry_tags.description: Shopify Theme Store industry categories. Select from Shopify's current category list. First item is the primary category.

catalog_size_tags.description: Shopify catalog size tags. Select all that apply.

style_entry.description: Named style entry from the HeyHi style reference library. Must match the style_entry in the paired active-brand.json. Used for preset naming and generation metadata.

presets.description: Theme presets. Each preset is a distinct visual configuration of the same theme. Minimum 1 preset. Multi-preset themes require listings/ directory structure.

name.description: Preset name shown in the Theme Store. Short, evocative. Not the same as the theme name.

industry.description: Primary industry this preset targets. Should correspond to a demo store in this industry.

catalog_size.description: Catalog size this preset is optimized for.

demo_store_handle.description: Shopify development store handle for this preset's demo store. Set during Session F-3. Must be populated before submission.

color_scheme.description: Primary color scheme for this preset. 'light' or 'dark'. Dark-native configs from active-brand.json should set 'dark' for the primary preset.

hero_pattern.description: Named layout pattern for the hero section in this preset. References patterns in references/section-patterns.md.

description.description: Optional short description of this preset's aesthetic intent. Not shown publicly — used for generation context.

section_library.description: Section generation preferences. These values supplement the active-brand.json cluster architecture — they select within the cluster's structural range.

cluster.description: Design cluster for section architecture selection. Must match brand.cluster in active-brand.json. Drives structural section generation rules in references/section-patterns.md.

spacing_density.description: Section padding density. Drives default padding tier applied to all sections. Must match layout.spacing_density in active-brand.json if that field is present.

hero_style.description: Structural layout style for the hero-banner section. Must be architecturally valid for the active cluster.

collection_layout.description: Default layout for the collection/product grid. Must be architecturally valid for the active cluster.

typography_anchor.description: How typography anchors section hierarchy. Informs heading treatment across all sections.

card_style.description: Product card visual style applied to product-thumbnail and featured-collection sections.

compliance.description: Shopify Theme Store compliance flags. All must be true before Mode A submission. These are assertions — the operator confirms them after manual verification.

skeleton_theme_base.description: Theme is built on (or structurally equivalent to) the Shopify Skeleton Theme. Required for Theme Store review — Shopify expects OS 2.0 section structure throughout.

exclusive_to_shopify.description: Theme is exclusive to the Shopify Theme Store — not sold through any other channel. Required by Shopify Theme Partner agreement.

no_app_dependencies.description: No core functionality depends on a third-party app. App blocks (type: @app) are allowed as extension points. This asserts that the theme works completely without any app installed.

wcag_aa_verified.description: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance verified for all color token pairs in the default color scheme. Required for submission. Set true after heyhi-theme-validator Profile 3 PASS.

lighthouse_performance.description: Lighthouse Performance score on the demo store home page (desktop). Shopify requires >= 60. Record actual score from Session F-3.

lighthouse_accessibility.description: Lighthouse Accessibility score on the demo store home page (desktop). Shopify requires >= 90. Record actual score from Session F-3.

validator_pass_date.description: ISO date when heyhi-theme-validator last returned a PASS result (all 3 profiles). Required before submission. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

demo_store_review_complete.description: A human reviewer has manually reviewed the demo store on mobile and desktop. All sections render correctly. No placeholder content. No Lorem Ipsum.

documentation_live.description: Theme documentation page is live at documentation_url. Includes setup instructions, section guide, and minimum 5 FAQ questions.

support_contact_live.description: Support contact form at support_url is live and operational. Email response process confirmed within 2 business days.

meta.description: Generation metadata. Populated by heyhi-shopify-theme during build.

generated_at.description: ISO datetime when this config was created.

active_brand_config.description: Filename of the active-brand.json this theme was generated from (e.g., 'quiet-craft.json'). Enables tracing theme back to its token source.

active_brand_version.description: Version of the active-brand.json at theme generation time (e.g., '1.0.0'). Enables detecting config drift.

last_build_date.description: ISO date of the most recent full theme build. Update after each generation run.

submission_status.description: Current submission status. Progress through Phase 4 lifecycle.

notes.description: Free-form notes about this theme config. Revision history, reviewer feedback, known issues.

theme.name: Ember
theme.description: A focused theme for artisan food and drink brands. Clean typography and spacious layouts let product photography carry the story.

presets.name: Ember
presets.description: Light, spacious. Small-batch olive oil producer.
